#| label: tbl-inhospout
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| tbl-cap: "In-hospital course and outcomes"
#| tbl-pos: "H"

outtabfunc <- function(x, data, stratavar, catdig) {
  pmis <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(stratavar))) %>%
    mutate(mis = factor(if_else(is.na(!!sym(x)), 1, 0), levels = 0:1)) %>%
    count(mis, .drop = F) %>%
    mutate(pmis = fn(n / sum(n) * 100, catdig)) %>%
    filter(mis == "1") %>%
    pull(pmis)

  tmp <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(x)) & !is.na(!!sym(stratavar)))

  cl <- class(data %>% pull(!!sym(x)))
  if (cl %in% c("character", "factor")) {
    out <- tmp %>%
      group_by(!!sym(stratavar), .drop = F) %>%
      count(!!sym(x), .drop = F) %>%
      mutate(
        out = paste0(n, " (", fn(n / sum(n) * 100, catdig), ")"),
        out = case_when(
          n == 0 ~ "-",
          n < 10 ~ "<10",
          TRUE ~ out
        ),
        level = !!sym(x)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(!!sym(stratavar), out, level) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = !!sym(stratavar), values_from = out)

    # p-value
    check <- tmp %>%
      count(!!sym(stratavar), !!sym(x))
    if (nrow(check) >= 4) {
      p <- fn(chisq.test(tmp %>% pull(!!sym(stratavar)), tmp %>% pull(!!sym(x)))$p.value, p = T, dig = 3)
    } else {
      p <- "-"
    }

    # if levels No, Yes only present Yes
    levs <- out %>% pull(level)
    nlevs <- length(levs)
    if (nlevs == 2 & all(levs %in% c("No", "Yes"))) {
      out <- out %>%
        filter(level == "Yes") %>%
        mutate(
          var = x,
          p = p,
          pmis = pmis,
          level = NA
        )
    } else {
      out <- out %>%
        mutate(
          var = NA,
          p = NA,
          pmis = NA
        )
      out <- out %>% add_row(
        var = x,
        p = p,
        pmis = pmis,
        .before = 1
      )
    }
  } 
}

catdig <- 0
tab <- escdata %>%
  count(Bili_mgdL_cat, .drop = F) %>%
  mutate(
    Overall = sum(n),
    n = paste0(n, " (", fn(n / Overall * 100, catdig), ")")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Bili_mgdL_cat, values_from = n) %>%
  mutate(
    var = "N (%)",
    level = NA,
    p = NA,
    pmis = NA
  ) %>%
  select(var, level, pmis, levels(escdata %>% pull(Bili_mgdL_cat)), p)

tabtmp <- lapply(c("death_inhosp", "DCWHF", "ITDIURH", "ITNITH", "vaso_dobuta_dopa_milri_enox_lev", 
                   "vaso_norepi_epi_vasopress", "ITSTMEC"),
  FUN = outtabfunc, data = escdata,
  stratavar = "Bili_mgdL_cat", catdig = catdig
)
tabtmp <- bind_rows(tabtmp)

deathcause <- outtabfunc(x = "death", data = escdata %>% filter(death_inhosp == "Yes") %>% mutate(death = droplevels(death)), 
                         stratavar = "Bili_mgdL_cat", catdig = catdig)

tab <- bind_rows(tab, tabtmp, deathcause)

tab <- left_join(tab,
  metaesc,
  by = c("var" = "variable")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = coalesce(label, var),
    Variable = if_else(!is.na(level) & !is.na(Variable),
      paste0(Variable, " ", level),
      coalesce(Variable, paste0("  ", level))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, pmis:p)

levs <- levels(escdata %>% pull(Bili_mgdL_cat))
cn <- c("Variable", "Missing (%)", levs, "p-value")

if (output) {
  make_one_xlsxsheet(tab, colnames = cn)
}

# footnotes
tab <- tab %>%
  mutate(
    # so no probs
    Variable = sanitize_text(Variable),
    Variable = str_replace_all(Variable, fixed("²"), "\\textsuperscript{2}"),
    Variable = str_replace_all(Variable, fixed("$>$="), "$\\geq$"),
    Variable = str_replace_all(Variable, fixed("$<$="), "$\\leq$")
  )

indent_rows <- tab %>%
  mutate(
    indent_rows = str_detect(Variable, "  "),
    rows = row_number()
  ) %>%
  filter(indent_rows) %>%
  pull(rows)

cn <- sanitize_text(cn)

default_kable(tab,
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = cn
) %>%
  add_indent(indent_rows) %>%
  footnote(
    footnote_order = c("general", "symbol", "alphabet"),
    general_title = "",
    general = c(
      "Presented with n (%) and tested with chi-square test."
    ),
    threeparttable = T
  )
